test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 09 May 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option.

I am sorry that I was unable to see _____ of you over the summer.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 1'** i.e. **'More'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct alternative to fill in the blank is:** 'More'.**
 
• **In this sentence,** the speaker is expressing regret for not being able to see the person they are addressing more frequently.
 
• Therefore, the word **"more" **would be the most appropriate choice to indicate a greater frequency or extent of seeing the person.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *'I am sorry that I was unable to see **more **of you over the summer.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The options **"many,"** **"much," **and** "many more" **do not fit the context as well.
 
• **"Many" **and **"much" **are typically used for quantifying countable and uncountable nouns respectively, but seeing someone isn't a quantity that can be counted or measured in the same way.
 
• **"Many more"** is a combination of the two and implies a significantly greater quantity or number, but it is too intense for this context and doesn't fit the sentence structure as well as "more" on its own.
